label: Прямой / Кривой
description: Прямой vs кривой: straight/crooked contrasts across genders and everyday scenes.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative agreement. 'Прямой' takes the masculine ending to match 'путь'. The travel image anchors the form in a concrete scene.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative agreement. 'Кривая' takes the feminine ending to match 'ложка'. The household detail roots the feminine form in daily life.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative agreement. 'Кривое' takes the neuter ending to match 'крыльцо'. The everyday observation makes the neuter form concrete.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative agreement. 'Кривые' takes the plural ending to match 'доски'. The vivid image fixes the plural form in mind.
Strategic focus: Direct feminine contrast. 'Прямая' is nominative for 'дорога' while 'кривой' is genitive for 'тропинки' after 'лучше'. The comparison pairs both adjectives in one thought.
Strategic focus: Masculine predicate adjective. 'Кривой' follows the noun as a predicate describing 'гвоздь'. The everyday remark grounds the form in daily life.

missions.phrase: Он дал мне прямой и честный ответ.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Figurative masculine sense. Here 'прямой' means direct or honest and matches 'ответ' in the masculine. The sentence shows the abstract use of the adjective.
Strategic focus: Feminine predicate adjective. 'Прямая' follows the noun as a predicate describing 'спина'. The habitual remark fixes the feminine form.
Strategic focus: Short-form feminine predicate. The short form 'пряма' states a present quality of the subject 'линия'. Short forms are typical when describing a current state.
Strategic focus: Comparative form. 'Прямее' is the comparative of 'прямой' and stays the same for any gender. The sentence compares one street to another.
